entries.title: Christmas limited event
entries.text: A Christmas event runs until midnight on December 31. Collect Jingle Bells to earn a Turtleneck outfit.

entries.title: 2015 New Year event
entries.text: Pio joins the quest characters. Complete quests to earn both New Year costumes.

entries.title: Kutata’s birthday event
entries.text: Even on Valentine’s Day, developer Kutata has no chocolate! The fairy Kutata appears at random; tap her repeatedly to earn the Cake outfits.

entries.title: Halak’s birthday event
entries.text: Take on the limited ‘Halak’s Birthday Party’ quest to earn Pio’s blue Summer Dress and the Blackcat Fairy.

entries.title: 300,000 downloads celebration
entries.text: Collect the cakes that appear among the ingredients to earn Tia’s Nurse outfit.

entries.title: 2015 Summer event · Part 1
entries.text: Take on the limited ‘Explore the Ocean’ quest to earn Pio’s Frill Bikini and the Six Tail Fairy.

entries.title: 2015 Summer event · Part 2
entries.text: Summer vacation is open—let’s visit the event spots! Earn Tia’s Sports Bikini and three fairies as event rewards.

entries.title: 2015 Summer event · Part 3
entries.text: Collect Coconut Juice to earn Tia’s Cami Dress and Pio’s Summer Dress.

entries.title: Succubus event
entries.text: Pio and Tia are trapped in a succubus’s dream! Wake them and chase the succubus to earn Pio’s Succubus outfit. A limited quest can also help you obtain the Succubus Fairy.

entries.title: 2015 Halloween Party
entries.text: Take on the limited ‘Halloween Party’ request to earn Pio’s Halloween costume and the Halloprin Fairy.

entries.title: 500,000 downloads celebration
entries.text: A rush of customers is coming—sell potions quickly! The original event offered Tia’s Blazer outfit as its reward.
